w:r.w:t: Checklist document for award categories, yearly coverage, and missing-data tracking
Prepared for Pitflix awards curation workflow
1. Use one section per award provider.
2. Mark each year as Complete, Partial, Missing, or Not Applicable.
3. Track both category coverage and nominee-level asset coverage.
4. Use the Notes column to flag renamed, retired, or newly introduced categories.

This document is a working audit template for the awards currently visible in the product flow: Academy Awards, Primetime Emmy Awards, BAFTA Film Awards, and Golden Globe Awards. It is designed to help you compare your local JSON coverage against the categories you expect to support across years, then quickly identify missing editions, missing categories, missing winners, and missing poster/backdrop metadata.
Global data fields to check for every award edition
awardId, year, ceremony label, subtitle, event poster, hero backdrop
categoryId, display name, sort order, media scope, active/retired flag
title/name, mediaType, tmdbId, poster/backdrop, credited people if relevant
winner flag or winner ordering, tie handling, winner notes
slug consistency, duplicate nominees, broken image paths, missing years
